title: Amaazia Water Park & Amusement Kingdom
location: Opp. Dumbal Transport Godown, Vesu Canal Rd, Parvat Patiya, Surat, Gujarat 395010
description: Beat the heat at Surat’s premier water theme park featuring world-class spiral slides, multi-lane racers, a massive wave pool, and lazy river channels. Proper synthetic/nylon swimwear is required for all water rides. Lockers and shower facilities available on premise.

title: Woop! Trampoline & Adventure Park Pass
location: Dumas Road, Near Decathlon, Bhimpur, Surat, Gujarat 394550
description: An action-packed indoor adventure hub featuring wall-to-wall trampolines, foam pits, rope courses, slam dunk zones, and dodgeball arenas. Grip jump socks are mandatory for arena entry. Suitable for all age groups with trained marshals on deck.
